environment.build: debug app with embedded frontend, launched through LaunchServices; separate temporary bundle

scope: WebKit-only 19-operation integration observations on this Mac; not a release or cross-OS runtime certification. Chromium is excluded from this record.

checks: immediate wait on a delayed first document reaches the helper and clicks once
a stalled image does not block helper-ready DOM interactions
first-request browser identity and native responsive resizing preserve document state
native blank tabs and per-tab zoom/reset preserve form state
ref click, controlled input, select, check, no app bridge
shared store within session, separate store across sessions
native site metadata and origin clear preserve other sessions and reject stale URLs
navigation observes a new complete document and rejects its old same-tab ref
page dialogs return denied defaults without a UI or pending callback
automatic popup is blocked and page-created background tab preserves selection
nativeFull.snapshotPrivacy: The full serialized snapshot is checked for absence of password, OTP, card and sensitive textarea fixture values.

trustedMainFrameBlankLink.method: REA AXPress on the selected temporary app window and link

popup.attemptWithoutClick: An initial observation-only run reached its no-click timeout; the following actual AXPress run passed.
popup.limits: Named targets, iframe links and button window.open are conservatively denied.

lifecycle.resourceScope: Short process RSS/CPU observations only; no sustained performance or leak-free claim.

placement.scope: Real artifact/native-view placement, hidden/restored views and one bounded menu-cover PNG.

policy.dialogs: Alerts complete silently; confirms return false; prompts return null.
policy.permission: Memory-only Rust grants approved through ordinary session chat cards; no frontend authorization map.
policy.search: Non-address text receives a local hint and is never sent to a search provider.
policy.chromium: Excluded from this PR; proposed separately and not exposed through UI/tools/IPC.

limits: Capture denial below macOS 27 and Intel runtime remain unverified.
OpenCode trackpad parity, sustained resource cost and all composer/popout focus arrangements remain unverified.
Native interactions dispatch script events; sites can reject them. Closed shadow roots are opaque and manual iframe picking is not implemented.
No model/provider requests were used for these native fixtures.

readinessRegression.initialRetest: A post-merge retest failed because a DOM operation reached WebKit before its isolated helper existed.
readinessRegression.fix: A bounded, original-tab readiness wait dispatches the operation once after helper installation, without waiting for all resources.
